description: GTEx tissue expression of GATAD2B and IMPC mouse knockout phenotype summary
code:
import requests, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- GTEx bulk tissue expression of GATAD2B ----------
r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
               params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000143614.16","datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100},timeout=90)
js=r.json()
rows=js.get("data",js.get("medianGeneExpression",[]))
g=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("GTEx rows:",len(g), g.columns.tolist() if len(g) else "")
if len(g):
    g=g[["tissueSiteDetailId","median"]].sort_values("median",ascending=False)
    g["tissue"]=g.tissueSiteDetailId.str.replace("_"," ").str.title()
    brain=g[g.tissueSiteDetailId.str.startswith("Brain")]
    print("\nTop 12 tissues by median TPM:"); print(g.head(12).to_string(index=False))
    print("\nBrain regions median TPM: n=%d, median=%.1f, range %.1f-%.1f"%(len(brain),brain["median"].median(),brain["median"].min(),brain["median"].max()))
    print("Non-brain median TPM: %.1f"%g[~g.tissueSiteDetailId.str.startswith("Brain")]["median"].median())
    from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(brain["median"], g[~g.tissueSiteDetailId.str.startswith("Brain")]["median"], alternative="greater")
    print("Mann-Whitney brain > non-brain: U=%.1f, p=%.4g"%(u,p))

# ---------- Figure: IMPC Gatad2b phenotypes + GTEx ----------
impc = pd.DataFrame([
 ("Preweaning lethality, complete penetrance (MP:0011100)","homozygote",0.0),
 ("Abnormal retina morphology (MP:0001325)","heterozygote",4.9e-10),
 ("Abnormal retina inner nuclear layer morphology (MP:0003733)","heterozygote",2.16e-5),
 ("Decreased locomotor activity (MP:0001402)","heterozygote",5.97e-5),
 ("Increased monocyte cell number (MP:0000220)","heterozygote",1.02e-5),
 ("Increased mean corpuscular volume (MP:0002590)","heterozygote",1.67e-5),
 ("Increased circulating alkaline phosphatase (MP:0002968)","heterozygote",3.93e-5),
], columns=["phenotype","zygosity","p"])
impc["negLog10P"]=-np.log10(impc.p.replace(0.0,1e-12))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.2))
colors=["#C44E52" if z=="homozygote" else "#4C72B0" for z in impc.zygosity]
axes[0].barh(impc.phenotype[::-1],impc.negLog10P[::-1],color=colors[::-1])
axes[0].set_xlabel("-log10(p), IMPC statistical pipeline")
axes[0].set_title("IMPC Gatad2b$^{tm1b(EUCOMM)Hmgu}$ significant phenotypes\n(red = homozygote, blue = heterozygote)")
axes[0].axvline(-np.log10(0.05),ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)

if len(g):
    top=g.head(20).iloc[::-1]
    cols=["#C44E52" if t.startswith("Brain") else "#8C8C8C" for t in top.tissueSiteDetailId]
    axes[1].barh(top.tissue,top["median"],color=cols)
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Median TPM (GTEx v8)")
    axes[1].set_title("GATAD2B expression, top 20 tissues\n(red = brain regions)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
